node.title: Re^3: Sort mechanics problems... (updated)
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
and see if I still get $a and $b for free

You can get at them:

use warnings; use strict; { package Bar; my $obj = Foo->new; print join ", ", sort {$obj->mysort($a,$b,"bar")} qw/x a o/; } { package Foo; sub new { bless {}, shift } use Data::Dump 'pp'; sub mysort { pp \@_; $_[0] cmp $_[1]; } } __END__ [bless({}, "Foo"), "x", "a", "bar"] [bless({}, "Foo"), "x", "o", "bar"] [bless({}, "Foo"), "o", "a", "bar"] x, o, a

Updated example: Previously I had mysort reaching into the main package via $::a, which is obviously not the best solution, now I'm passing $a and $b as parameters. (I see the AM made the same suggestion.) Update 2: There are [id://464990|other] [http://stackoverflow.com/questions/11508333/using-a-sorting-subroutine-from-another-package|solutions] possible as well.

Hope this helps,
-- Hauke D
